discussion_comments.comment_body: The comment here is inaccurate. If the server cap is 30s, the renderer will never wait up to 120s for a legitimate response because the server falls back and returns after 30s. Setting a 120s timeout here doesn't actually allow responses up to 120s; it just mismatches the server timeout.
